decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - REASON FOR APPROVAL

It is considered that the proposed single-storey side extension and single storey rear extension, because of design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of No. 494 Staines Road and complementary to the visual amenity of the locality, would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties and shall preserve and enhance the character and general appearance of the conservation area. On balance, the development is in accordance with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is generally compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines. It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
description: Demolition of existing garage and erection of single storey rear extension and replacement of garage to dwellinghouse.
